subject: Marketplace channel listing prioritization + ops roadmap
body:
--- Message 1 ---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace channel listing prioritization + ops roadmap

Team —

Putting a short proposal on the table for how we prioritize listings and co-sell readiness across AWS / Azure / GCP for the next 6 months. I attached an initial SKU matrix (marketplace_sku_matrix.xlsx) and a draft ops timeline. High level:

- Phase A (Dec–Jan): list a single entry-level SKU per cloud (entry bundle, 2 vCPU equiv, 8GB KV cache) in 3 primary regions each.
- Phase B (Feb–Mar): add performance SKUs (8 vCPU equiv and quantized variants) plus Europe expansion.
- Phase C (Apr–Jun): enterprise bundles, private deployment offering in marketplace or linked procurement for Dedicated.

Proposal rationale: speed-to-market for co-sell eligibility beats breadth early on. If we get the entry SKU live + co-sell checklist completed with AWS and Azure, we unlock field motion for Q1.

Questions for this thread:
1) Are the SKU definitions in the attached spreadsheet realistic to ship as a single listing per cloud?
2) Which regions should we prioritize for each cloud to balance latency coverage vs. certification overhead?
3) Ops readiness ask: what resources do we need from Platform/Oncall to support first 2 weeks post-launch?

Please reply with redlines and any regulatory flags (data residency, KMS/HSM) you foresee. I want to lock a final list by EOD Friday so we can start legal and marketplace onboarding early next week.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Partner GTM — Redwood Inference
---

--- Message 2 ---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace channel listing prioritization + ops roadmap

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear draft. Quick notes after a skim of the spreadsheet:

- SKU shapes: agreed on entry + perf + enterprise tiers. Rename "8 vCPU equiv" to "perf-8" and "entry-2" for consistency with cloud catalogs.
- Regions: prioritize by cloud:
  - AWS: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1
  - Azure: eastus, westeurope, southeastasia (for APAC coverage in phase B)
  - GCP: us-central1, europe-west1, asia-south1
- Co-sell triggers: we should require 2 things for a listing to be eligible for field co-sell: (1) Marketplace listing live and (2) co-sell checklist signed with partner PM. Otherwise we risk mismatched expectations.

Ops resource ask: Platform will need a small playbook + one dedicated oncall rotation for 2 weeks post-launch per cloud (can be same oncall with escalation playbook). I stubbed a rough timeline in ops_rollout_timeline.pdf.

I'll loop legal on the doc with a narrow question about data residency for EU customers when we firm up enterprise bundles.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Cloud Partnerships — Redwood Inference
---

--- Message 3 ---
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace channel listing prioritization + ops roadmap

Jonas/Karthik —

Agree with the shape. A few additional practicals from the listings side:

- SKU naming & metering: each cloud wants normalized unit descriptions. We should publish both vCPU-equivalent and a token-equivalent for transparency to customers.
- Billing: recommend we initially publish list prices that map to current hosted API tiers so billing is consistent for customers moving between Redwood Hosted -> Marketplace procurement. Markups for marketplace fees should be absorbed by our pricing team (Marissa).
- Marketplace metadata: include clear fields for supported features (streaming, function calling, private deployment available). That increases discoverability.

I'll set up a 30-min sync with AWS and Azure partner PMs next week. Draft invite will include the cosell_checklist.docx so partners see the expected gating items.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Cloud Listings — Redwood Inference
---

--- Message 4 ---
From: Peter Hsu <peter@cloudone.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Marketplace channel listing prioritization + ops roadmap

Thanks for the ping, Jonas & Vanessa —

CloudOne supports a lot of customers in Financial Services who will pay for region-localized deployments. A couple of asks from our side:

1) Make sure EU region SKUs include EU KMS support in metadata; procurement teams will want that on day one.
2) For the enterprise bundle, consider a "managed private" SKU that ties a listing to a matched Dedicated capacity offering — that makes procurement easier for our customers.

Happy to join the partner sync next week and provide a short case study for the co-sell play.

—Peter
Peter Hsu
VP, CloudOne Solutions
---

--- Message 5 (Decision summary) ---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace-pm@amazon.com>, Azure Co-sell Ops <azure-cosell@partner.microsoft.com>, GCP Partner Sales <gcp-ps@google.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace channel listing prioritization + ops roadmap

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround. Final decisions from this thread:

1) SKU set to publish in Phase A (Dec): entry-2, perf-8, enterprise-50 (enterprise-50 will be a "placeholder" listing with contact-to-procure until we build private deployment flow).
2) Regions for Phase A: AWS (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1); Azure (eastus, westeurope, southeastasia); GCP (us-central1, europe-west1, asia-south1). We will expand APAC regions in Phase B based on early telemetry.
3) Co-sell gating: listing live + signed cosell_checklist.docx with each partner PM. No co-sell until both are met.
4) Ops: Platform provides a 2-week oncall window per cloud with an escalation playbook. Marissa — pls coordinate pricing alignment and marketplace fees.
5) Next steps: Vanessa to run partner sync week of Nov 23; Karthik to open legal ticket for EU KMS language; Jonas to file HubSpot task HS-2345 to track go/no-go.

Attachments for record: marketplace_sku_matrix.xlsx, ops_rollout_timeline.pdf, cosell_checklist.docx

I'll move this to Confluence and mark the action owners. If there are any objections, raise them by EOD Monday.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Partner GTM — Redwood Inference
